Name: Set Up Stripe Subscription Tiers
Description: Implement the subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, and Enterprise) in Stripe and ensure they are accurately reflected in the app. Update the pricing page to show these tiers.

Name: Frontend: Integrate Stripe Elements
Description: Use Stripe Elements for the checkout process. Ensure the form is in line with the app's design and handles errors such as invalid card details or insufficient funds. Include a clear comparison of features for each tier and a prominent checkout button.

Name: User Dashboard Enhancements
Description: Develop the user dashboard to include current plan details, billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access to invoices/payment history, and update payment methods. Ensure it reflects subscription status in real-time and notifies users of any changes.

Name: Backend: Handle Subscription-Related Tasks
Description: Integrate Stripe's API for managing subscriptions, processing payments, and handling webhooks for events like successful or failed payments and subscription cancellations. Ensure these are reflected correctly in the system.

Name: Webhook Handlers Setup
Description: Create handlers for the following webhook events: invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Ensure they update the system accurately and include scenarios for testing payment failures and cancellations.

Name: Frontend-Backend Integration
Description: Ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend. Changes in subscription should reflect in real-time on the dashboard, with proper error notifications to users.

Name: Testing Plan
Description: Develop a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow. Include edge cases and ensure everything functions as expected within the testing week post-integration.

Name: User Documentation and Support
Description: Prepare comprehensive user documentation, including a help section or FAQ, covering subscription management, invoice access, and troubleshooting common issues.

Name: API and Webhook Documentation
Description: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers for ease of maintenance and troubleshooting.

Name: Progress Review Meeting
Description: Schedule a follow-up meeting next week to review progress and address any arising issues. Ensure team members provide updates and communicate any blockers.
